title: Persistent-Device Scheduler Overhead
claim: PTO CUDA persistent-device should expose device-side scheduler overhead and task-dispatch behavior because CUDA has no Ascend-style AICPU scheduler.
promotion_gate: Promote when PTO persistent-device, MPK, and VDCores all have comparable A100 or Hopper-class artifacts with scheduler traces, task counts, resource policy, correctness, latency distributions, and an explicit measurement scope separating diagnostic instrumentation from final baseline timing rows.
